verdict.rationale: Cold-start latency is a fair question for an on-device inference runtime, so the axis applies. The pack never documents startup time, model-load latency, or binary size. The "one C++ core, six thin bindings" claim describes cross-platform architecture, not cold-start speed, and streaming output addresses time-to-first-token after inference starts rather than startup.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
